_readme: S399 SkyRowan, 2026-10-16. Wave 5's curriQunet read of Gavilan College found no program: the start page named no catalog id and no title in the host's _getCatalogs list matched the college's name (run 38935131822: 0 of 120 found). This read prints the calls the start page's scripts make and the host's own catalog list, so the reader's catalog-id choice can be fixed against what the host serves. Two page loads, no model call.

questions.catalog_id: Which catalog ids the start page's scripts request, and which catalogs the host's _getCatalogs list names (id, title, deleted or active), for the 2026-2027 catalog.
